mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 56 degrees at Fireman's Park, with a first quarter moon gracing the sky.

The city is actively working on the Mark Drive reconstruction project, which is currently in phase two, along with various street rehabilitation projects like Gateway Pass and Enterprise Drive to improve our local roads.

There is plenty to do in our community, including the Epic Systems UGM, Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and Hop Haus Trivia, all taking place today, followed by live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
In a noteworthy call for service on Friday, a 44-year-old woman was arrested for an O W I after officers found her unresponsive in her vehicle and observed her continue driving upon waking.
The delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. While they are currently closed, you can stop in to grab a scoop starting at 10 AM today.
